title: Beal's Conjecture (Tijdeman-Zagier Conjecture)
exact_target: Whenever the sum of two positive perfect powers equals a third and all exponents exceed two, must their bases share a prime factor?

sources.citation: R. D. Mauldin, The Beal Conjecture and Prize, University of North Texas; announced in Notices Amer. Math. Soc. 44 (1997), 1436-1437.
